g.text: 100% message loss separates tolerant and dependent policies
Paper metrics only. A diamond marks 100% remote-message loss; self-links remain active.
100 episodes/condition | actual seed 0 | one trained checkpoint/map | no between-seed CI
Dashed lines connect loss 50% and 100%. Intermediate rates were not evaluated.
